translations.web: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
translations.bsb: He endured their conduct for about forty years in the wilderness.
translations.kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
translations.asv: And for about the time of forty years as a nursing-father bare he them in the wilderness.
